preconditions: Owned JSON values or a field-valid explicitly supplied artifact plus an update with an expected revision and/or canonical hash.
steps: Apply real RFC-6902 operations in order on an isolated value snapshot.
Compile ordered set/unset inputs without implicit parent creation or type conversion.
Check supplied target, revision/hash and controlled fields before returning a field-valid candidate; ensure original values are unchanged.

oracle.requirement_contract: `specroad artifact update <ID>` MUSS RFC-6902-Patches sowie die Komfortoptionen `--set <JSON-POINTER>=<JSON-VALUE>` und `--unset <JSON-POINTER>` unterstützen und eine erwartete Revision oder einen erwarteten Hash verlangen.
oracle.scope: Pure RFC-6902 value execution and guarded artifact candidates. No live storage reads, full Change Plan folding, metadata advancement, lifecycle approval, CLI command or publication.

open_items: Wire artifact-update CLI and planner to the same preview/normalization path in the scheduled authoring step.
Apply full Change Plan folding, metadata advancement, profile/lifecycle validation and transaction-bound live preconditions in later steps.
Proposal planning must include both revision and hash; this authoring input API accepts either and checks both when supplied.
Full supported Python matrix is evaluated by CI; local selected tests are not complete suite evidence.
